name: Imouto Senbatsu☆Sousenkyo ~365-nin no Imouto Icha Love Manifest~
original_name: 妹選抜☆総選挙 ～365人の妹いちゃラブマニフェスト～
source:
April 1st is the day when the world is full of lies, however to Kouta, it is his precious imouto’s birthday. His father returned that day after a long time away and told him: “Actually Kouta… you have 364 other imoutos”. He was still confused when his father brought him to Tachibana Gakuen. He was the only guy at the school. The other 365 students were… all his imoutos.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/12/06/december-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
4月1日是谎言充斥全世界的一天，对橘康太而言，却是宝贝妹妹的生日。久未归家的父亲恰好在这天回来，对他说：“其实，康太……你还有另外364个妹妹。”康太尚未弄清状况，父亲便把他带到橘学园。整所学校里只有他一个男生，其余365名学生……全都是他的妹妹。

[译自 [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/12/06/december-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
